Moggalāna
See also entries under Fausboll 158. JRAS. (1902) 171-74.
See Pāli Lit. an. Lang. p.. 55fn 2. 5b.

Moggallāna Thera
(12th Cent.) flourished in the reign of Parākrama Bāhu I, 1153-86 A. D. an. lived in Dhū (Thū) pārāma monastery a. Anurādhapura. See Alwis, p.. 183-86.
--Moggallānavyākaraṇa or Saddhalakkhaṇa. One of the three important works of Pāli gr. [Page195-a. shows a. improvement on Kaccāyana; perhaps later than Saddanīti; Ind. Cult. XV. p. 200.
Pt.. Visvesvarananda Inistitue Publication, Hoshiarpur, 1965.

Moggallā(ya)navyākaraṇa
Pāli gr. diff. from the school of Kacchāyana. Copen Pāli p. 149. Filliozat II. p. 141. (padasādhana). Br. Mus. Pāli p. 144.
See Pāli Lit. an. Lang. p.. 53-54.
--by Moggalāna Thera. IO. Pāli p. 94 (no. 74). Pt.. Colombo, 1890.
See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1876-92. 235.
--C. Vṛtti. or Vatti. Colombo p. 55 (2 mss.). Colombo D. I. 2100. 2101. Paris Pāli p. 37.
--C.. Vipulatthaprakāśinī. Paris Pāli p. 37.
--C. Pañcikā by a. himself. partly in Pāli an. partly in Sinhalese. said by a. few to be written by Moggallāna himself, others ref. a. one of the works of the Ceylonese Thera Sāriputta or Sāgaramati of Parakkramabāhu I's rule (1153-1186 A. D.). See Ind. Cult. XV. p. 200; also Pāli Lit. an. Lang. p. 54. Mentioned in a. inscription a. Pagan 1442 A. D. See Bode, Pali text of Ceylon, p. 145.
--C.. Pradīpa by Rāhula Vācissara Thera of Toṭagamua. See Pāli Lit. an. Lang. p. 54. Colombo p. 55. Colombo D. I. 2125.

Moggalā(ya)napadasādhana
by Piyadassi. Work in gr. based upon Moggallāna Vyākaraṇa.
See under Padasādhana. See Pāli Lit. of Beybon, p.. 187, 205. [Page195-b]
Filliozat II. p. 141. Paris Pāli p. 37.

Moggallānasaṃyutta
Bud. Pāli. Sn. 40 of Samyutta Nikāya. See Dict. of Pali Propernames p. 668.
Pt.. Samyuttanikāya, Sn. 40. Nalanda Dig. Pali Ser. Patna 1954.

Moggallānasutta
